notes.title: Tailor Simulator Playtest is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Tailors, 
             We’re excited to announce that the Tailor Simulator Open Beta Playtest is live! Whether you’re a casual player or a simulation enthusiast looking for something fresh, now’s your chance to get an early taste of the game.



We’ll be releasing a public demo during the upcoming Steam Next Fest, but before that, we need your help to test and polish the game through this open beta playtest. Joining is simple and free – just visit our Steam store page and click “Request Access” to join right away



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/ad294e418ad075f28ce4eae5b13a8ebbf9d8b66f.png"]            

        By joining the playtest, you’ll experience Tailor Simulator ahead of time and help us spot imbalances, bugs, or areas for improvement. Your feedback means the world to us! Share your thoughts in our Reddit community or on our Discord server – tell us what you enjoy, what could be improved, and any issues you run into. With your support, we’ll shape Tailor Simulator into the best version possible for launch. 



 Thank you for being part of the journey – have fun trying out the game!

 See you soon in the demo!

notes.title: Devlog#1 - New Fabrics, Skill Tree, Update Cycle and More
notes.content:
First Devlog Just Arrived 


Hello Tailors! Welcome to the first Tailor Simulator devlog. We’re excited to share some key pre-launch content updates. In this post, we’ll introduce new features and improvements coming to the game, including a fresh Sandbox Mode, a deeper progression system, and an expanded selection of fabrics and clothing.


Sandbox Mode to Design and Manage Your Workshop Customization
We’ve added a Sandbox Mode that lets you design every aspect of your workshop’s customization from a single interface. Want to expand your shop’s floor space, or change the storefront decor? You can do it all without jumping between different menus. You can see freely with layouts and designs, planning out the perfect workshop. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/11f458d36153d73f5a8aebe0e73497e75193183a.gif"]


Skill Tree and Update Cycle
The Update Cycle is the game’s way of gradually unlocking core tools and fabrics as you progress through the game or reach certain milestones. It provides the essential equipment and materials you need to grow your collections. Skill Tree builds on that foundation, letting you specialize and unlock additional content through your play-style. As you level up and meet certain goals, you’ll earn skill points to spend on various new collections on the Skill Tree. This allows you to unlock brand-new outfit types and special customer orders. For instance, one branch of the tree will enable you to craft complex military uniforms that come with strict requirements and challenges.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/8426c14d4cf475c78c8fe0e603095b926e04ddc5.gif"]


New Fabrics and Clothes
We’ve added several new fabrics and clothing designs to expand your creative possibilities. Each new fabric type comes with its own look and feel, so you can craft outfits that stand out in your shop. These materials will help you deliver exactly what your customers are looking for. We have even more fabrics and outfit designs planned for future updates, so you’ll never run out of options. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/bd13e067243a8e591a720dfbb9301d2b9f56c479.gif"]



We’ll continue to refine and polish the game as we approach launch, and we’ll keep you updated with more devlogs along the way. As always, thank you for your support and for joining us on this journey. 
That’s all for Devlog #1.

notes.title: Tailor Simulator: A Creative Workshop Management Experience
notes.content:
What Is Tailor Simulator
 Tailor Simulator is not only about sewing clothes. It is about running a shop, working in a creative space, and meeting different customers as well. You will explore a small but lively world, full of surprise. We're giving you a deeper look at what you can actually do in the game and what makes it truly unique.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/1fe40c95e69879d072ce7e0b09177b9704994023.png"]
Core Features in Early Access

Create collections with over 250,000 mix-and-match options    

Keep track of your shop's economy and stock    

Complete orders from customers with different personalities and needs    

Get to know the people in the Emporium District and build your reputation    

Make smart business choices like prices, ads, and shop layout    

Decorate your workshop with new furniture and interiors

Meet customer needs that change by time and season    

You can grow your workshop as a fashion designer or enjoy calm days in a cozy, personalized workshop.  All choices is yours. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/4f75ab0991ca04321021f45a474c3c6cc64a8bcc.png"]
Why Early Access?
We are releasing Tailor Simulator in Early Access because we want to improve the game with your ideas. Indie games grow better when players help by giving feedback, finding bugs, and asking for new features. The main parts of the game are ready, but we plan to add more. This includes new shop features and more ways to design.   

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/1031551e825212596c2261a1bdf35a5556b61408.png"]
Roadmap & Release Plans
Tailor Simulator is almost ready and we are working on the final details. We plan to launch in Q4 2025, just before the winter season. This gives us time to make the game better and more fun before it releases.  Before that, you can play the Demo which will be released during Steam October Next Fest. This will give you a small preview of the gameplay, style, and workshop experience. A detailed road map will be released after Steam Next Fest October.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/a212da868eff34127633bc70b4cc54c0305c7313.png"]
Join the Journey
We are building this game with you. Join us on Discord and Reddit to share ideas, report bugs, or talk with other players. Your feedback will help shape the future of the game.  

Wishlist now. Step into the Tailor Simulator's world on Q4 2025

    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602608/ef1a4c19a60c20949f61e75f76f981f0b735c244.gif"]

notes.title: Tailor Simulator is Officially Announced!
notes.content:
Hello Tailors!
We’re excited to officially announce Tailor Simulator, a creative and strategic simulation game where fashion meets business! Whether you’re sewing custom suits, organizing your inventory, or dealing with your customers, this game puts you in charge of every detail.


[previewyoutube="MXxq-xGlB7c;full"][/previewyoutube]

In Tailor Simulator, you will
Design clothes and combine them with 250.000+ alternative combinations    

Manage your own tailor shop's inventory and finances  

Build relationships with people  

Make business decisions that shape your growth 

Explore a charming small open-world environment called Emporium District   

As you master your art, you'll unlock new fabrics, tools, customer types, and shop upgrades that make your tailor shop truly one-of-a-kind.   


From Workshop to Empire: A True Business Simulation
From humble thread to fashion empire, your choices matter. Tailor Simulator blends real business logic with the creativity of design, giving you the full freedom to build, grow, and succeed.  

Stay Updated
We're still deep in development and can't wait to share more through devlogs, videos, and community feedback. Wishlist Tailor Simulator to follow our journey.   


Join the Community
Join us on Discord, Reddit, and social media for sneak peeks and early impressions from our development journey.
